test_check_sms_requirements: test the check_sms_requirements function to verify SMS adapter dependencies are available
build_sms_adapter: build a Twilio SMS adapter instance using SmsAdapter with a PlatformConfig for outbound SMS and inbound webhook handling
run_sms_connect: run the SmsAdapter.connect method to start the aiohttp webhook server and initialize the Twilio HTTP client session
send_sms_message: send an SMS message via SmsAdapter.send to a phone number with automatic markdown stripping and message chunking
validate_twilio_signature: validate the Twilio webhook signature using SmsAdapter._validate_twilio_signature with HMAC-SHA1 and URL port variant handling
